title: Manu is Born! 🎉
description: The world got a little more colorful. Welcome, Manu!

title: First Scribbles ✏️
description: Manu discovered crayons and the walls were never the same again!

title: Colors Everywhere!
description: Started recognizing colors and naming them. 'Pink!' was the first favorite.

title: First Recognizable Drawing
description: Drew a person for the first time! It had a big round face and stick arms. Masterpiece!

title: Started Art Class
description: Manu joined art class and fell in love with painting. Every day was art day!

title: Turned 5 — Art Party!
description: Birthday cake shaped like a paint palette. Best party ever!

title: First Art Exhibition
description: Manu's drawings were displayed at school! So proud!
